name: the Weeping Ladies
about: Statues of women on top of the colonnade at the Palace of Fine Arts. They face into the tops of the columns, hiding their faces, as if crying.
check: the colonnade of the Palace of Fine Arts: tall stone columns, ideally with the statues on top

name: the Rotunda
about: The big domed rotunda in the middle of the Palace of Fine Arts, built for the 1915 world's fair to look like a Roman ruin.
check: the domed rotunda of the Palace of Fine Arts, or its huge columns and arches

name: the lagoon
about: The pond in front of the rotunda at the Palace of Fine Arts. It was once a mudhole; now ducks swim in it and the dome reflects in the water.
check: the lagoon at the Palace of Fine Arts, with the water clearly visible
